channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.description: Two prominent members of Ron DeSantis' communications team have publicly alleged that Layla Collins, wife of Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins, operated anonymous social media accounts to promote her husband's gubernatorial campaign while attacking the Governor. item.description: The Martin County School Board is challenging a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy since 2009, who was suspended following Facebook comments about conservative activist Charlie Kirk. item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year as inflation drives up food prices
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description:
A 40-year-old man died in a head-on collision on State Road 710 in Martin County early Sunday morning, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. The crash occurred around 2 a.m. near the intersection of State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane.

item.title: Anthem Blue Cross denies breast cancer patient's reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: A breast cancer patient and her surgeon are speaking out after Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled in Treasure Coast.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council moves forward with Midway Road Turnpike interchange, $95 million widening project
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike at Midway Road.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation attracts international artists to Fort Pierce with residency program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, putting the Peacock Arts District on the map and connecting local and international artists through a residency program.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire, community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. The community has launched a fundraiser to help her fiance rebuild.

item.title: St. Lucie County Marine Unit rescues two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit deputies.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation to nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation project expected to wrap by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams pulled out of her Wimbledon doubles match with sister Venus on Saturday after injuring her right knee during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Defending champion Argentina edges Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time to advance in World Cup
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina survived a scare from underdog Cape Verde in a World Cup Round of 32 match that went to extra time in South Florida.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is targeting a state title in the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district championship. item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Nine-Game Skid With Late Comeback Win Over Tarpons
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets ended their nine-game losing streak Sunday afternoon with a late offensive surge, rallying past the Tampa Tarpons for a 10-5 win at Clover Park.

item.title: Byron Donalds raises $90 million for Governor's race as opponents struggle to keep pace
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds' campaign for Governor has raised $90 million, with nearly $10 million in his campaign account and more than $76.2 million in his political committee, while his Republican primary opponents lag far behind.

item.title: Florida students reach milestone with 60% testing at grade level in reading and math
item.description: For the first time in state history, 60% of Florida students tested at or above grade level in both reading and math on the annual Florida Assessment of Student Thinking exam.

item.title: Four Florida municipalities receive $7.2 million in FEMA grants for Hurricane Ian recovery
item.description: FloridaCommerce announced $7.2 million in FEMA grants for Charlotte County, Port of the Islands, Seminole County, and Palatka to fund infrastructure projects related to Hurricane Ian recovery and future storm preparedness.

item.title: President Trump's actions draw comparisons to monarchy as nation marks 250th anniversary
item.description: The 250th anniversary of America's independence from Britain has sparked debate about presidential power, as President Donald Trump's second term actions lead historians to draw parallels with King George III.

item.title: Americans express measured views on nation's 250th birthday amid political divisions
item.description: As the United States celebrates its 250th birthday, many Americans are focusing on local community and personal concepts of patriotism rather than national political divisions.

item.title: European World Cup fans face economic pressures at home despite extended U.S. visits
item.description: While European soccer fans appear to have escaped work for extended World Cup trips to the United States, rising tax burdens and aging populations are straining the welfare systems that fund their vacation time.

item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is establishing Fort Pierce as a vibrant artistic destination while maintaining the historic Crain Estate.
